title: Big Cat Sketching Safari
content: Paleoartist Mauricio Anton helped to organize a safari to northern Botswana to sketch big cats in the wild. He filmed and edited  a video about it, and he wrote the music, too. (Direct link to video)He'll be doing the safari againif you're interested in joining in.Mauricio Anton has written and illustrated several books, includingSabertooth (Life of the Past)
